name: Sabine
headline: Turn Drei’s usage data into subscriptions that stay.
saw: Most telecom offers still reach customers by tariff and contract date rather than by how each person actually uses their connection, their data and their bundles. Every customer in the same group receives the same message, whatever their situation.

The usage signal you already own, such as data consumption, roaming, plan changes and contract renewals, sits in analytics and billing, not in the message the customer receives. That is where the next upgrade and the next cancellation both show up first.
Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are usually built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from usage drops, plan changes and contract dates, so the customer about to leave gets the right offer, channel and moment this week, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next bundle that fits
cases.text: Next best bundle or add-on for each customer, based on what they use and what they never touch. Fewer blanket upgrade mails, more offers that fit each person’s actual usage.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every customer using the service
cases.text: Keep each customer using what they pay for. Personal content, data and roaming nudges across email, SMS and web, so every customer has a reason to keep using the service.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
